sources.title: Download industrial emissions and waste transfer (UK PRTR) data
sources.guard: UK PRTR facility releases are high-value reported emissions evidence, but individual records must be pollutant-, method-, year-, facility- and geometry-checked before parcel promotion.

sources.title: UK Pollutant Release and Transfer Register (PRTR) data sets
sources.guard: PRTR measured, calculated and estimated method codes must remain explicit; thresholded facility reporting is not cadastral parcel attribution.

sources.title: Pollution Inventory
sources.guard: Annual mass releases from regulated industrial sites are measurement candidates; permit-wide scope, fugitive releases, units and site geometry must be preserved.

sources.title: Pollution Inventory - Defra Data Services Platform
sources.guard: Dataset metadata and downloadable inventory files support facility emissions extraction but do not by themselves bind a release to a cadastral parcel.

sources.title: Environmental Permitting Regulations - Industrial Sites Quarterly Summary
sources.guard: The March 2026 installation snapshot is a strong facility/permit binding surface; it is not an emissions measurement without a compatible emissions dataset.

sources.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data
sources.guard: NAEI national, point-source and gridded products have different spatial semantics; only point-source records with explicit coordinates may advance facility binding.

sources.title: NAEI Data
sources.guard: Dataset catalogue membership is provenance metadata; each selected product needs its own year, pollutant, spatial resolution and method validation.

sources.title: Emissions from point sources
sources.guard: Known-location point sources with grid references are high-value candidates, but NAEI notes some values may be reported, estimated or modelled and must be method-labelled.

sources.title: Gridded Emissions Data
sources.guard: 1x1km gridded emissions cannot be treated as cadastral parcel measurements; attached point-source files may be evaluated separately with geometry checks.

sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024
sources.guard: Accredited national and SIC statistics are authoritative aggregate context, not facility or parcel observations.

sources.title: Provisional UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2025
sources.guard: Provisional territorial estimates are subject to revision and remain national/sector aggregates rather than site measurements.

sources.title: 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions provisional figures methodology summary
sources.guard: Growth factors, held-constant categories and projections explain provisional statistics and must not be promoted to observed facility values.

sources.title: UK territorial greenhouse gas emissions statistics
sources.guard: Collection-level final/provisional publications provide authoritative temporal context but no parcel geometry.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions: final
sources.guard: Final territorial data are aggregate official statistics; facility attribution requires a separate site-level source.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions: provisional
sources.guard: Provisional national data are useful for cross-checking totals and trends only, not parcel-level emissions.

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas
sources.guard: ONS industry-by-gas estimates are economic-account aggregates and cannot be assigned to an individual installation or parcel.

sources.title: UK Environmental Accounts: 2026
sources.guard: Environmental-account totals and industry tables provide macro validation, not site measurement or geometry evidence.

sources.title: Using UK greenhouse gas inventory data in UK ETS monitoring and reporting: country-specific factor list
sources.guard: 2026 carbon factors and calorific values are approved calculation inputs only when an installation monitoring plan and compatible activity data are present.

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme: technical guidance and tools
sources.guard: MRV guidance, factors and templates define accounting controls but do not prove a facility emission quantity.

sources.title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026
sources.guard: Conversion factors need compatible activity data, units, year and scope; factors alone are never emissions observations.

sources.title: Conversion factors 2026: statement of voluntary compliance with the Code of Practice for Statistics
sources.guard: Quality and provenance assurances increase source confidence but do not turn factors into site measurements.

sources.title: UK government conversion factors for company reporting of greenhouse gas emissions
sources.guard: Annual factor collection establishes vintage control; activity and facility evidence remain mandatory.

sources.title: Incinerator Annual Monitoring Reporting
sources.guard: Annual operator monitoring reports are high-value measurement candidates; report rows need extraction, unit, pollutant, period, facility and geometry validation.

sources.title: Incinerator Annual Monitoring Reporting - Defra Data Services Platform
sources.guard: Environment Agency dataset metadata confirms public report packages but individual measurements remain unpromoted until row-level extraction and binding.

sources.title: Public Registers Online
sources.guard: Permit number, operator, address and available compliance records are valuable facility-binding evidence, not emissions measurements.

sources.title: Air Pollutant Emissions Data
sources.guard: Air-pollutant point-source products can support facility identity and cross-checks but pollutant scope must not be confused with greenhouse-gas quantities.

sources.title: About the inventory
sources.guard: Integrated GHGI/AQPI methodology and shared activity data support provenance, not parcel-level observation claims.

sources.title: London Energy and Greenhouse Gas Inventory (LEGGI)
sources.guard: LEGGI is a city-level inventory useful for regional cross-checking; it must not be interpreted as facility or parcel data.

sources.title: Sustainability Reporting Guidance 2025-26
sources.guard: Public-sector accounting guidance explains use of activity data and conversion factors but is not an observed-emissions source.

sources.title: Control and monitor emissions for your environmental permit
sources.guard: Monitoring obligations and MCERTS requirements specify controls; actual certified results are required for measured claims.

sources.title: Landfill methane: measurement and metrics
sources.guard: Measurement-method research is authoritative method evidence but not a site-specific result without explicit measured flux and site scope.

sources.title: Monitoring landfill gas surface emissions: LFTGN 07
sources.guard: Survey procedure and compliance thresholds must remain separate from actual observed methane flux, survey geometry and annual mass.
